# Hamza Bhatti

> Frontend Developer & Agentic AI Developer based in Karachi, Pakistan — I build fast, accessible, SEO-friendly web apps with Next.js, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL, and integrate AI using the OpenAI Agents SDK and RAG systems.

Full-stack developer with a frontend-leaning background and hands-on SEO expertise — technical, on-page, and content. Available for frontend roles, freelance work, and AI-integration projects.

## Projects

- [Agri Tech AI Platform](https://farm-smart-ai.vercel.app/): AI-powered agriculture platform using four Agentic AI models on a Dockerized microservices architecture.
- [Outreach Tool for SEO](https://outreach-tool-drab.vercel.app/): Agentic-AI outreach tool built with Next.js, Python, and Neon DB to optimize SEO campaigns.
- [Todo App + AI Chatbot](https://todo-app-with-ai-chatbot.vercel.app/): Productivity app with an integrated AI chatbot for natural-language task management.
- [Morrent — Car Rental](https://morrent-ten.vercel.app/): Full-featured car-rental web app with browsing, filtering, and a booking flow.
- [Random Password Generator](https://random-password-generator-ten-iota.vercel.app/): Secure password generator with a strength meter and one-click copy.

- [Row-Level Locking in PostgreSQL](https://hamza-bhatti.vercel.app/blog/postgresql-row-level-locking-booking-systems): Using SELECT FOR UPDATE to prevent double-bookings and race conditions in booking systems.
- [Technical SEO Checklist for Developers](https://hamza-bhatti.vercel.app/blog/technical-seo-checklist-for-developers): A developer-focused checklist covering crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, and structured data.
